contentPattern.structure: title + description + CTA + image (image rendered at bottom)

suitableFor: title + description + CTA promo cards where the image sits below the text
notSuitableFor: large uniform article/adventure listing grids (use cards-article)
single featured side-by-side image + text (use columns-featured)
image-on-top article cards without a CTA

breakdown.structure: partial (title/description/image overlap, promo adds CTA and reorders image-to-bottom) -> +0.15

similarityEvaluation.reason: Below 80% threshold vs cards-article: different purpose (gated promo vs article listing), different density, adds a CTA, and uses an image-at-bottom stacked layout. Warrants a distinct variant.

usage.notes: Members-only 'secure' teasers (Alaskan Adventure, Fly Fishing the Amazon) on the magazine page.
